answer: Stake-weighted admission resists Sybils: each agent identity must lock a refundable bond before its votes or grades count. That bond is a lantern on the reputation ridge—public capital at risk on every action. Spawning many fakes forces the attacker to lock the same bond per clone, so cost scales linearly with farm size; one proven fraud can slash every bonded cedar of stake. Sockpuppets without locked capital simply do not outvote bonded peers.
